metadata.question: Does the urban area of Medina, Saudi Arabia expand between June, 1984 and July, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Medina, Saudi Arabia (approximately 24.47°N, 39.60°E) - Dates: June 1984 vs July 2018 - Collection: Landsat (Landsat 5 TM for 1984, Landsat 8 OLI for 2018) - Band: Use NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) or simple band ratios to detect urban areas 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask both images (QA_PIXEL for Landsat 8, BQA for Landsat 5) - Focus on built-up pixels (high NDBI values indicate urban development) 3. Logic: - Calculate NDBI for both periods - Count pixels with NDBI > 0.1 (urban threshold) for each year - Compare: If 2018 urban pixels > 1984 urban pixels, answer is A (Yes, expanded) - If 2018 < 1984, answer is B (No expansion) - Handle missing data (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or calculation failures (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Medina, Saudi Arabia geometry const medina = ee.Geometry.Point([39.60, 24.47]); const roi = medina.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer for urban area analysis // June 1984: Landsat 5 TM let col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('1984-06-01', '1984-06-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1984 = col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images found: ${size1984}`); if (size1984 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 5 images for June 1984.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // July 2018: Landsat 8 OLI let col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2018-07-01', '2018-07-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Images found: ${size2018}`); if (size2018 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 8 images for July 2018.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Process 1984 image: Calculate NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) // NDBI = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) for Landsat 5 const img1984 = col1984.first(); const ndbi1984 = img1984.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']) // B5=SWIR, B4=NIR .rename('NDBI'); const urbanMask1984 = ndbi1984.gt(0.1); // Urban threshold // Count urban pixels in 1984 const count1984 = urbanMask1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Urban pixels (NDBI>0.1): ${Math.round(count1984 || 0)}`); // Process 2018 image: Calculate NDBI for Landsat 8 // NDBI = (B6 - B5) / (B6 + B5) for Landsat 8 const img2018 = col2018.first(); const ndbi2018 = img2018.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']) // B6=SWIR1, B5=NIR .rename('NDBI'); const urbanMask2018 = ndbi2018.gt(0.1); // Count urban pixels in 2018 const count2018 = urbanMask2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Urban pixels (NDBI>0.1): ${Math.round(count2018 || 0)}`); // Validation if (count1984 === null || count1984 === undefined || count1984 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in 1984.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (count2018 === null || count2018 === undefined || count2018 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in 2018.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Compare urban expansion const expansion = count2018 - count1984; console.log(`Urban area change: ${expansion > 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(expansion)} pixels`); if (count2018 > count1984 * 1.05) { // Allow 5% threshold for noise console.log('A'); } else if (count2018 <= count1984 * 1.05) { console.log('B'); } else { console.log('C3'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
